security_audit.summary: Most static shell-execution findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences and prompt examples, not executable Ruby backticks. The line 21 install instruction is confirmed critical because it pipes a remote script directly into sh; the related hardcoded installer URL is also confirmed. No additional semantic prompt-injection or data-exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.suggestion: Replace the curl-to-sh installer with a package-manager install, a pinned version, and checksum or signature verification steps.

remediation.issue: Remote installer URL without integrity verification
remediation.suggestion: Document the trusted source, expected digest, and manual approval step before any external installer is executed.

content.user_title: Improve AI Prompts Across Text, Image, and Video
content.value_statement: Many prompts produce vague or inconsistent model results. This skill teaches structured prompts, examples, constraints, and model-specific wording for Claude, Codex, images, and video.
actual_capabilities: Explains a reusable prompt structure with role, task, constraints, and output format.
Shows role prompting, task clarity, chain-of-thought, few-shot examples, and structured output requests.
Provides image prompt guidance for subject detail, style, composition, quality terms, and negative prompts.
Provides video prompt guidance for shot type, subject action, setting, style, and camera movement.
Compares prompt tips for Claude, GPT-4, FLUX, and Veo style workflows.
Includes reusable prompt templates for code review, content writing, and image generation.
limitations: The skill is a guide and does not guarantee model accuracy or safety.
Examples depend on inference.sh models and may need account setup.
It does not validate prompts against policy, privacy, or copyright requirements.
Some examples include command-line usage that should be reviewed before execution.

use_cases.title: Improve Team Prompt Quality
use_cases.description: Create shared prompt patterns for support, analysis, writing, and coding tasks.

use_cases.title: Design Better Image Prompts
use_cases.description: Write prompts with clearer subjects, style cues, composition, and negative prompt terms.

use_cases.title: Build Reliable AI Workflows
use_cases.description: Use examples, constraints, and output formats to make repeated model runs more predictable.

prompt_templates.title: Clarify a Simple Task
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite my prompt for clarity. Goal: [goal]. Audience: [audience]. Constraints: [constraints]. Desired output: [format].

prompt_templates.title: Create a Few-Shot Prompt
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a prompt with three examples. Task: [task]. Good outputs should show [qualities]. Bad outputs should avoid [issues].

prompt_templates.title: Design a Generation Prompt
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a generation prompt for [medium]. Include subject, setting, style, composition, lighting, motion, and negative terms where useful.

prompt_templates.title: Refine a Production Prompt
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this prompt for ambiguity, missing context, conflicting constraints, safety concerns, and output format risks. Then provide a revised version.

output_examples.input: A vague request asks the model to help with code.
output_examples.output: The improved prompt names the language, expected behavior, current failure, constraints, and requested fix format.

output_examples.input: An image prompt only says to create a cat.
output_examples.output: The revised prompt describes the cat, setting, lighting, camera style, composition, and terms to avoid.

output_examples.input: A team needs consistent customer review summaries.
output_examples.output: The prompt defines sentiment labels, confidence expectations, evidence rules, and a concise summary format.

best_practices: State the role, task, constraints, and output format before adding examples.
Use concrete examples when style, tone, or classification rules matter.
Review command examples before running them in a local or shared environment.
anti_patterns: Asking broad questions without context, audience, or success criteria.
Combining conflicting instructions that make the desired output unclear.
Running installer commands from a guide without checking the source and integrity.

faq.question: What does this skill help me do?
faq.answer: It helps you write clearer prompts for LLM, image, and video generation tasks.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance is compatible with Claude, Codex, Claude Code, and similar AI tools.

faq.question: Can it create prompts for images and video?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for image subjects, style, composition, negative prompts, camera motion, and video actions.

faq.question: Does it run models automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides examples and guidance. Users choose whether to run any CLI commands.

faq.question: Are the prompt templates reusable?
faq.answer: Yes. The templates use placeholders that can be adapted for code, writing, analysis, and generation workflows.

faq.question: What should I review before using it?
faq.answer: Review any command-line installation instructions and confirm that external services match your security policy.
